const { Shape, Circle: Base } = require('./shapes');
const { add } = require("./util");
const path = require('path');
const [first, second] = list;
const { a: { b } } = nested;

class Circle extends Base {
  constructor() { super(); this.items = new Array(3); }
  draw() { this.describe(); this.radius(); return add(1, 2); }
  radius() { return Shape.create(); }
}

Circle.prototype.extra = function extra() { return this.draw(); };
Circle.prototype.other = () => path.join('a', 'b');

module.exports = { Circle, make: () => new Circle(), util: require('./util') };
module.exports.helper = function () { return first; };
exports.thing = 1;
